steps.text: Modern Day
4:14 P.M. \ Clear
Central Sargon, Ibut Region, Warzone

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: I find myself looking back on those events often, during my most difficult times.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Whenever I grow tired of striking the iron, whenever I am unsatisfied with inferior materials that result in products less than satisfactory—The events I witnessed that day immediately come to mind.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: —So you took care of all those mercenaries by yourself—?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No, he planted those weapons beforehand... and they self-destructed.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I'm surprised you could bring yourself to actually do it... Didn't you make all those things yourself...?

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: What kind of craftsman has lingering affection for their creations? The reason we pour our emotions into our work is to create an even more refined product, not to be tied down by our feelings.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: So you had it all figured out beforehand, eh?

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: I eliminated all the factors unbeneficial to us. What is wrong about that?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: —Ugh, this burnt smell stinks...

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Don't tell me Rhodes Island claims to be pacifist.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Though I can certainly tell you two are not.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: So... what did you see that day again...?

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Ah, has either of you personally seen her in combat?

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: It is as though she had a birds-eye view from up in the sky. Everything was under her control.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: We're close. Very close.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Sarkaz... Devils... She won. She won indeed. Old Isin knew this is exactly how it would turn out...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Ahem, do you have to follow me around?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Of course, Lady Kal'tsit asked Old Isin to. Until the moment she steps out of Sargon, her wish is Old Isin's command.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Hmm, is that her over there...?

a.text: On the other side of the hills, the smell of Originium gunpowder and blood yet lingers in the sandstorm, a phenomenon that has become all but natural to Elliot.
A gust of wind blows past, carrying away with it the dust. Under the clear sun, the strange creature's large stature appears as though it is distorting even the sunlight.
She is as calm and quiet as one can be.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: *Cough*—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You could've become a warrior, nameless mercenary. A Sarkaz Warrior.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: My death... is for a greater purpose, Caster.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Not going to finish me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's see—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Angry low roar)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Tsk... This monster... I'm more than ready to die. Are a few extra scratches that much to ask for?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Roars)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Enough, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He's a dead man with those injuries.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Dissatisfied hisses)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hah... Looks like we saved the padishah some trouble...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz... What's your name...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Pfft... Which one?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Tell me, Caster. The Kazdel you were talking about... How does it look now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Terrible still.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But the Sarkaz are rebuilding their homes.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Home...? How could us devils... us Infected possibly have one...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I've never left Sargon...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Sarkaz have tried to rebuild 'Kazdel', their home for centuries, though they have never succeeded.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Everyone has a different idea as to what the term 'homeland' means, but as it stands right now, Kazdel is perhaps as close as you can get to the term's original meaning.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The 'Teekaz' deserve a home.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Tsk... That does...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: ...have a nice ring to it...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Poor devil, poor devil. He is gone, no longer with us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You two shouldn't have come.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: You made quite a ruckus here. Old Isin thinks this place could use some cleaning to avoid catching anyone's attention...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You took all of them down by yourself...?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Shakes head in dissatisfaction)

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Um, okay. You two... took down a whole mercenary squad? How many of them were there?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was no easy task. I would've been in quite a tight spot if they weren't as afraid of Mon3tr as they were.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's pick up the pace. We've already found ourselves in seven skirmishes since we left Redhorn.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And now we have an entire Sarkaz mercenary squad. We'll likely face the lord ameer's guards next or the padishah's elite troops. No matter the case, the more we run, the more fierce our enemies become.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin gets the impression that you didn't want to kill them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're not wrong.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: You seem to have special feelings for Sarkaz... Oh, pardon Old Isin. Old Isin should not have asked.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: The sun is setting soon, Lady Kal'tsit. We must bury these bodies right away. It looks like their sand buggy will save us quite a bit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We need to be quick.

a.text: Can knowledge be a means to buy over a person's heart? Elliot has never so much as thought about that. He used to be naive, but he was also gifted precisely because of this. Of course, he cannot understand why Old Isin would follow everything Kal'tsit says after that exchange of theirs.
It is as though he lives in the distant past. He merely gazes at the far end of Sargon's golden sands, waiting for someone to come give him the answer he has always sought.
Is knowing what the answer is all that he ever wanted?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: This... is the entrance to the old market. This is the Reefsteep Town.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Yet another Sargon town...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin knows where the entrance is... The old market is no secret. Anyone has the right to look for that which they want here.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Come with Old Isin.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Old Isin...? I thought you died in the golden sands!

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin is fortunate to survive.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Hm, are those two behind you Columbians...? Columbians on the run. That box they have gotta be worth some money, then.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Oh, relax. Why so tense? I'll give you 400 gold coins for that box.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sorry, but it's not for sale.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Ah, that's too bad...

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: No worries, I'm sure we'll have more chances to do business with each other. Isn't that right, Old Isin? Haha.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Please don't let it get to you, Lady. This happens often here.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: She isn't actually that curious about the box...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If she actually had her mind set on it, we well wouldn't be getting much sleep in the future.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: She opened at 400 coins...?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: This is the Reefsteep Black Market. The vibrant heart of Ibut.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: How long are we staying here...?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: This will be a long journey. It will take Old Isin time to prepare. Perhaps two weeks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Isin, I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Mm, what is this for...? Gold coins? Old Isin needs no money at all...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our enemies are still coming after us. We need to get the preparations done as soon as possible.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin understands, but please keep your coins. Old Isin is in no place to take them... and Old Isin still has much to ask you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well, I understand... Feel free to ask me any time. Even now.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Thank you... Old Isin is far too old... Old Isin has forgotten far too many important things.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Alas, most of those who remembers what I wish to know have come and gone. That is why Old Isin is looking for clues...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Lady, you are young. Normally, Old Isin would not hold out hope for those your age... but you know of that city, the secrets that disappeared in those great winds long ago.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you want to remember, old Savra?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin once served a padishah... The Padishah of the Land of Reefsteep. The padishah saw Old Isin as a friend and would even die for Old Isin. An honor Old Isin can never fully repay...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Yet... it has been far too long. Old Isin has forgotten the words of the padishah. Before Old Isin dies, Old Isin must remember his words.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The disaster that destroyed the city left you directionless.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: It has been too long, Lady. Look, you remember even that Catastrophe—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The padishah who ruled Reefsteep doesn't show up in the history books much, but, at the very least, the written accounts and folklores do not mention a Savra fortune teller.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It will probably take some time if you want to figure out who you are.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Oh, that's fine—Even if you must leave this place behind and there is still a long wait ahead, Old Isin will patiently await your return.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin dares not to die. Old Isin only asks you to remember this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I promise you.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Please, come with Old Isin. Old Isin has a home here. An old dwelling...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Umm...?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Isn't this just a normal—Wait, what's this?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Pure gold—?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You buried a whole mountain of pure gold here?!

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: These are Old Isin's riches... but Old Isin had no way to spend them. Now, Old Isin is glad to finally give them purpose.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's no small sum you have. Has no one gone after your riches before?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin was the padishah's favorite courtier. Even if Old Isin had not a bean to his name, Old Isin will always be protected.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin will get started with the preparations now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you want to know?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Far too much, my lady...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: But you possess all the answers.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: It feels pretty empty up here...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A black market always starts out as a normal underground bazaar. It's a fairly common sight for areas barraged by Catastrophes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When nightfall comes, the lights are moved underground.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Something on your mind?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I've been on the run with you for a while now, but you're still keeping me in the dark for a lot things. Like that old Savra with amnesia.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Long ago... there used to be a city here. The only nomadic city in Ibut's vast territory.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The building of a city is a miracle in itself, but, before the Reefsteep Padishah, no one had managed to unite all of Ibut. And the symbol of that unity? That city among the golden sands.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That was what inspired everyone to unite under his rule. That era was not that long ago, and I believe there are still a fair amount of people out there wallowing in their homeland's former glory.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unfortunately, it was not meant to last. The city met its fate during a Catastrophe. Supposedly, after the padishah had evacuated all his citizens and workers, he simply lamented and lashed out at the gathering storm.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Lash out... at the Catastrophe?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's how it was recorded in history, at least, but it most likely actually happened.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Catastrophe laid waste on the padishah's grand achievement in a brief moment. In just one night, all its citizens became refugees. They very well could have built a new home together, but with the destruction of the city... everything was left behind in that sandstorm, forgotten.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Old Isin was among them. The lords ameer and the new padishah didn't want to spend a huge sum of money to rebuild the city. Thanks to that, their descendants likely had no idea where to begin to rebuild their homeland.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This filled them with grief, and this is also why they give all those who still respect the 'Land of Reefsteep' the same amount of respect.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So... Is that why they're helping us...? Because it's like helping out their countrymen?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: From the looks of it, we'll get to leave Sargon soon, right?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If everything goes well, we should be leaving Sargon territory within the month.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: And we're going to Ursus?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I don't get it. Did you really abandon everything you had in Columbia and came to Sargon just to keep our research from becoming the powder keg that sparks a war?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: None of you could've possibly foreseen what the chain of events would eventually lead to.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: And you can...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you really want me to give you an answer, I'll say yes.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: It would be so much easier for you if you killed me and destroyed the box now... but, here you are, letting me hold onto it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you want me to do that?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: At first... I was really bothered that I was the only survivor, but I don't feel that way anymore.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Kal'tsit... If I give you this box now, will you do something for me... for us?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You know the Ibuti Lord Ameer was dragged into this mess. From Sargon to Columbia, the accomplices of this conspiracy are everywhere.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: But I still want them to pay the price...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: See, this box—It's my one and only trump card.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But once it's destroyed, you'll have nothing—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: —Nothing?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Actually... Kal'tsit, ever since the beginning, I've always felt I didn't need this box.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I remember all the details, and I can replicate our past results.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Of course, it'll take a long time, and there's probably going to be lots of difficult issues... but I think I can do it.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: If, just like you said, there's some kind of way to turn this Originium energy source into a weapon—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: This is the first time you are looking me in the eyes, Kal'tsit. The first time you aren't treating me as a kid or someone to be protected, but as a scientist, a Columbian.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps I've been underestimating you because of your age, Elliot.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Relax, I won't let these bad guys use the Professor's research as they please. I won't.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: But I will use it to finish one last thing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You don't understand how Professor Thorne's research came to be.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I heard him say before that the basis of the technology came from a set of ancient ruins that archaeologists found in Sarkaz, and it could provide nomadic cities an entirely new and convenient energy source—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —I'll say it again. If misused, this could easily bury half of Sargon under its golden sands.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Well, you were the head of the mercenaries to begin with. You probably have a few other tricks up your sleeve just to be safe, don't you, 'Adviser?'

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Such as... taking me out right now. The way you people like to take care of things.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Happy sounds)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go back inside...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Enough with the tough act, Elliot. With the way you are now, you can't make a sensible decision.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You should really think about what it is that you want to do carefully.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Thank you, thank you. This is all that Old Isin wants.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: You're going so far away?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin won't be going... Old Isin will go nowhere.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Alright, your call. You got the cash, and I got the goods. It's as simple as that.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: You need any help packing?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: No, no need. We must keep my lady's whereabouts a secret...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Isin.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Ah, my lady. The preparations are almost complete. We have medicine, food, water, and a small amount of refined Originium Ingots.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: This car here's stolen, and it's already been modified about four or five times by the Vouivre.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: It's kinda beat up, but that's the only downside to it. It's got everything you want in a car, even got a Multi-Grenade Launcher.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: I heard you guys are going north? Where to? Sami, perhaps? Whoa, will you guys actually make it that far?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: As for your compensation...

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: All pure gold? I ain't giving change, you know. That's a pain in the butt.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Just like how we were treated in the old days, Old Isin is never stingy when it comes to compensation.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: Heh. Well, thanks!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's call it a day here, Isin.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Very well, my lady... If all goes well, you will be departing on your journey within the next three days.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: —Leithanian Arts Units' parts are nice and all, but they're such a hassle to use, and they are usually pretty rough. The Columbians make much better stuff.

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: I got some new wares here... Originium weapons straight from Minos. They...

steps.name: Black Market Resident
steps.text: —Once you place the order, you gotta buy it. What about it don't you understand—

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: How lively... Old Isin doesn't hate this place at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you have wealth and status here, why roam the streets elsewhere in Ibut?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin wants to help Sargonians. This ideal helped Old Isin move forward and helped support his many lifetimes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Compared to the average lifespan of a Savra, you have lived quite a long time. Is this an effect of your Originium Arts?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin... has forgotten even what his Originium Arts could do... Old Isin can fiddle with this Originium crystal ball, but Old Isin does not remember what kind of tricks it conjured up back in those grand, radiant days.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This isn't a normal physiological disease. Your brain and body are under the influence of some kind of Arts.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Lady Kal'tsit... Old Isin thinks that, with the Reefsteep lost to the storm, perhaps there are no more clues to be found anywhere but in the centermost areas of Sargon...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Have you been to that fabled golden city?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You mean the capital of Sargon?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Though its industrial prowess has been advancing day by day, Sargon's capital has never once opted to relocate its nomadic city.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: In the winds, the sands ceaselessly beat against Sargon's walls as time goes on and on...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even Catastrophes cannot rock Sargon's core.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin thinks what he has forgotten is there. Old Isin can remember everything there... but that is a place that Old Isin can never reach...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only the padishahs and a few lords ameer who were granted the royal privilege may see that city hidden deep within the sandstorms.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You said you wanted an answer.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin remembers nothing but a dream... In the dream, amid those boundless hotlands, the armies simply charged toward the horizon devoid of people...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: All Old Isin remembers of it is that the Iron Heels hoisted a scarlet web and charged toward the southernmost horizons of Sargon.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: But this has nothing to do with the Reefsteep. Is this perhaps a key that could lead to Old Isin's past?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hang on a second. Could you—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You could not have known that... The conquest of the Kheshigs of Nightzmora took place over a thousand years ago... How does this have anything to do with Reefsteep?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Kheshigs... The Nightzmora's royal debt... Old Isin knows. Old Isin knows... but why?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you serve a Nightzmoran offspring?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The king of Sargon created a Kuranta of Nightzmoran blood padishah?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin... seems to...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Padishah... Reefsteep Padishah... Old Isin's master a Kuranta? A descendant of Nightzmora?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The two of you made for the Watchman's walls together, and he must have recounted to you the exploits of his bloodline... something that he must've taken pride in.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Walls, yes, but no mere city walls. It was to the south. Yes, the south! Atop the hotlands that not even Sargonians would set foot on, there stood the entrance to lands yet undiscovered by man—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Nightzmora... A Nightzmoran was created padishah, and the Ibut region was once the center of his political exploits.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He didn't choose to merely wallow in the luxuries promised to him by the lords ameer. Instead, his thirst for conquest drove him to...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: ...to conquer these deserts, yes... The padishah wanted to conquer these golden sands. He led the people, and built an entirely new city... A nomadic city...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: According to the history books, he almost succeeded.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for you, even though he treated you with nothing but benevolence, even though he passed away long ago... you remain lost in his life.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin remembers now...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin is not a gatekeeper... and certainly not the padishah's close friend... Old Isin was... just a jester before them...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: No... Old Isin remembers now... No, no, no... Was it those summer nights?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: *Cough*—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please, calm down a little.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Right... Age has left Old Isin's memories in a muddle... You are right... Once upon a time, the padishah would hold a banquet at his palace every starry night and address all those in attendance.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: No... No... *Whimpers*... Old Isin... was undeserving to bask in his glory and radiance... *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've been under his Originium Arts' influence, and the long nightmare has twisted your thinking... Though this is not something he had done to you deliberately.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: His subjects went voluntarily. There was none who could resist those extraordinary fantasies, curiosity, longing, and thirst for knowledge. All of it worked to keep us enthralled by the padishah's charm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You were lost in your own dreams.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: No... It shouldn't be... Old Isin shouldn't...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Please... Allow Old Isin a brief moment of peace... Please... leave Old Isin alone...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're leaving tomorrow.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What about Old Isin...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He needs some time to clear up his thoughts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Nightzmora had been tormenting him for way too long. He's been trying to embrace the past in his dreams.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I don't get it...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have no use for the box anymore.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was our final trump card, but now that we are leaving Sargon behind us, it makes no difference to us anymore.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: This is mine...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: The last thing I still have.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's why I'm leaving the decision to you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What will you do?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You're forcing me to make a decision...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not forcing you to do anything. Even if you are actually able to replicate technology behind it and break away from its original... form, with where the Originium industries are currently, that will do you no good at all.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Tsk...
The young researcher sets the box down after hesitating briefly.
He has almost completely forgotten what is inside the box despite the fact he has kept it on his person for the entire journey.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: This...
The blue Originium crystals are discharging tiny, stable sparks.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: It's beautiful...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Is this... really as dangerous as you've been making it out to be?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A simple sample such as this won't help explain why. Once you master the core principles behind it, you will be able to craft from it a grenade capable of wiping out an entire city with ease.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you think will happen if the Ibuti Lord Ameer or Padishah Murad got their hands on this technology?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: The technology is still being developed. The bad guys will get their hands on it sooner or later.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The truth is... this Originium crystal sample is the only one of its kind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As an Originium crystal, it actually isn't particularly special on its own. It is how it came to take its current form that makes it special. It was found in an excavation.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You can always count on the archaeologists to discover new secrets...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Columbians only ever found three Originium samples like this one. Without exception... they all came from the surroundings of a certain Sarkaz ruin.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What's going to happen if you destroy them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The sample's explosive range is hardly comparable to the electrical devices we use in experiments. However, because of its nature, it will nonetheless put us in danger—the danger of being infected with Oripathy.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Well, alright.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You said it's one of a kind? Well, then. I know how to take care of it now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Wait!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can't—Mon3tr, protect him!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Dissatisfied shrieks)
The boy smashed the beautiful crystal to pieces.
In an instant, the bright light of the electric sparks has engulfed everything in the immediate area.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Agh—Why... are you stopping me...?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Didn't you hear me...? This is a piece of Originium!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You will get infected!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Gah... hah...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So what?!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Do you hate the Infected? Do you despise them? Hah.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Well, perfect! I don't owe you anything anymore now—!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm Infected myself...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Uh—Wha—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Ugh... Argh...! It hurts...! My head...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Those are the symptoms of an acute infection. We need to get you treated right away.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I don't—Argh—need it—!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm just keeping you from turning to Originium dust within the next few hours.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You chose the wrong path, Elliot.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if you were trying to shatter your own fate, this is the worst possible method you could choose.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Ugh... Uhh... Eugh!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Elliot Glover...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are now an Infected. This is the fate you chose for yourself.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Aghh... Hahh...!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Well, this is just the perfect fate for me, then...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you don't want to live a life of suffering, I have many ways to set you on your way.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: No... I just... guh.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Perhaps this... will help me... break away from these shackles... Now I have nothing... to do with my past...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Sorry... for dragging you into this mess...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm surprised you can still apologize.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: That's because I hate you too, Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I thought you weren't going to treat me like a Columbian anymore.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: No... That's not why...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Do you really think you can decide somebody else's fate for them...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've never once thought I could.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: But that is exactly what you are doing, Kal'tsit... even though no one could say you made the wrong decision doing that...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: *Sigh*... but it's all coming to an end now, isn't it?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Ugh, ha...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This doesn't change when I will be leaving, and you need to lay down and get some rest right now.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So is this what Oripathy is...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It differs from person to person.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So does that mean... I don't need to use those Arts Units to conduct Arts Device experiments now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You haven't received any in-depth Originium Arts education, and it will just kill you even sooner.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So you are saying I can do it.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Yeah... That's not so bad.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Keep going straight, and you will reach another way out of the black market.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Only Old Isin knows of this exit. No one has even been here.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: An altar.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: A grave.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: My lady... There will be no obstacles in your way.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Elliot.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm going to Ursus.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I know that. Why are you telling me this now?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's not important. What I'm asking you is... Are you going to stick with me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You could go back to Columbia to continue your business. Before you make your decision, at the very least.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or you could stay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Old Isin is right. No one controls fate itself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He will help you.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: If that is my lady's wish, Old Isin will offer you his assistance, dear child.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You're saying all this now...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can't decide your future for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if you try to prove to me you're cutting off ties with your past, no matter how extreme your methods, you know from the beginning this is how you've always felt deep inside your heart.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm stopping war, I'm stopping the Sargonian civil unrest set off by the legacy of Sarkaz witchcraft, and I'm preventing a large-scale Originium infection—That's my goal, to put it simply.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So you're saying... You've already succeeded?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: And what do you think of all those people who died on your quest?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I get it. I know you saved me. You were really there to save us, and I owe you my life—But they weren't just making preparations for war. That's not their crime—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: —War has already started, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You've seen it, haven't you? You've been in so many battles on your journey. How many people have you killed? And how many of them were out to kill us?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: The padishah, the lords ameer. The civil war has started already. If all this come to an end, does it really mean they will gladly set aside their differences and start throwing parties?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You don't understand how the Sargon nobles and the lords ameer work. Their corruption and pride will bog them down.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: So you'll just... come up with some pointless summary and get up and leave?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I can't, Kal'tsit. Sorry... but I can't.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you want to do?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I will find every last one of them...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: From Sargon to Columbia.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: All of them.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Ah... Persistence.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Looks like the child has made up his mind, my lady.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is the choice he made, Isin.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin knows. Old Isin respects both of your wishes. Old Isin is very old, after all. Old Isin wants to leave behind a kindling that will spark a new fire...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Will you help me?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: To the best of my ability, my child.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Then, Kal'tsit—

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: It's time for us to say goodbye.

a.text: Newly awaken from his nightmares, the old man reminisces the glory of the old days as tears well up in his eyes.
The young researcher contemplates to himself. The anger welling up in him manages to suppress even the pain of his infection.
As for Kal'tsit, she merely stays quiet, saying not a word.
The nomad then takes her leave by herself.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: My lady... Please do not forget Old Isin's reward.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: In some twenty years, you will return with a gold coin to take away with you this helpless soul.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, it's time to go.
